item: The import queue refuses a backup whose manifest the restore always refuses, before the run starts (row 97)
summary: A backup whose manifest lists a volume twice, points at a link or names an unsafe path can never import with any passphrase; found inside a run it failed there and discarded the backups staged in its checkpoint group. backup_manifest_refusal runs the restore's own two structural checks (the same functions, so they cannot disagree) on each corpus item at start, and the start is refused naming each such backup and the reason, before any passphrase is tried; a missing or damaged volume, no manifest or another kind gives no verdict and stays the restore's to report. Evidence: tests/test_import_queue_manifest_refusal.py (8 cases; the start test fails with the queue call removed). Found by the security read of #2057.
